notes.title: Vote on new Trailmakers features!
notes.content:
Hi Trailmakers!

Today I want to talk to you about a very cool fan-made initiative called the Trailmakers Suggestions Trello - a place where you can let us know which features you would most like to see in Trailmakers.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28341931/2fcd3476e263d1be13632e70ade1b98207502a23.png[/img]

Some enterprising players on our [url=http://discord.gg/Trailmakers]official Discord server[/url] (please like and subscribe) have taken it upon themselves to create and curate a very large list of feature suggestions for future Trailmakers updates. As developers, this is by no means a checklist that we feel we have to complete before 1.0, but it is a great source of reference for when we discuss updates internally. 

When considering a new feature, we have to weigh a lot of factors first. Do we (the developers) want it in the game? Do the players want it in the game? Is it good for new players? And for old players? Is it time consuming to develop? The Trello list is one of the places we refer to when we ask ourselves “what do the players want?”. Some of the features on the list will be added, some will be solved by adding other features, and some of them will probably never make it to the game. 

Since launch we’ve implemented these highly requested player suggestions:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28341931/1a13d32720fd13b98f7fb0dd9b4b6bfeb13b628a.png[/img]

If you want to vote for any of the suggestions on the list, all you need is to make a Trello account. If you want a feature added to the board, go to our Discord and post it in the #feature-suggestions room - a helpful moderator will either add it, or let you know if it already exists.

You can find the Trello here: https://trello.com/b/aSShFsXY/trailmakers-suggestion-list 
And our Discord server here: http://discord.gg/Trailmakers

notes.title: Roadmap - Coming Soon(er or later)™
notes.content:
Let’s talk about some of the things that we are working on!

We are a fairly small team working on Trailmakers, but we have big ambitions for the game. This week, I’d like to let you in on some of the things we are working on or have planned for the future of Trailmakers! Some are coming soon, some are coming later, and some are coming sooner or later.

SUPER IMPORTANT NOTE: Some of these features are more speculative than others. Some are being implemented now, others are on the drawing board, and some might be scrapped if they end up not being fun. 

[h1]Treasure Hunt[/h1]
Coming soon!

One of the core elements in Trailmakers is exploration. We’ve been working on something tentatively called Treasure Hunt that will lead you on a small mission for some new blocks! It’s an experiment to see if these mini-expeditions can be fun to add as recurring content. A Treasure Hunt is most fun if it’s shrouded in secrecy, so I wont say too much about it except I think the treasure will blow you off your… seat.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/lBNJhIJ.jpg[/img]

[h1]Ocean Updates[/h1]
Coming later!

From the very launch of Trailmakers, one of the most requested features has been improved water physics, graphics, and vehicle parts to go along with it. In coming updates, we are going to get our hands wet, and give the area an overhaul. 

When we launched the Alpha Demo, you could already make something that acted like a boat, due to the wheels having a bit of upward buoyancy. Stack wheels all around a vehicle, and you had a “boat”. It was a fun one-off, but not satisfying to play with at length because the water wasn’t very realistic, and the vehicles looked like floating cars. 

The Ocean Update will be not be one update, but several. The first one will overhaul the graphics of the water so it looks better from above, and even when you stick your head under. This update will also add a few blocks that supports building water vehicles. 

In the second update we will change the way water behaves when you interact with it. This will hopefully enable fun creations like hydrofoils, and make sure your speedboat actually skims the water. 

The third update will make the water “come alive”. We want to make sure there are waves, currents, splashes and foam trails from the boats. When it comes to making water physics over network, it can have scary implications on overall performance, so the scope of the third update is very much up in the air.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ixS1Zin.jpg[/img]

[h1]Challenge Editor + New Biomes + Prop Blocks[/h1]
Coming sooner or later!

We’ve mentioned the Challenge Editor before, and it’s still in our plans for the future. The Challenge Editor will be a way for players to make their own courses in the game by placing props like checkpoints, ramps, loops etc., and even making rules and restrictions for their challenge. The Challenge Editor will NOT be a level editor in the original sense, but a way to modify the existing terrain to make your own race courses, expeditions or engineering challenges, and then play them with friends. This feature is still on the drawing board, but we’re really excited about it.

As an addition to the Challenge Editor. We have noticed one of the ways people play the Trailmakers sandbox is by making their own mini-games. Who can float the longest without propulsion? Who can do the longest wheelie? Who can climb this mountain without using the roads? We are considering making a group of blocks that can deposit props in the world. The props wouldn’t despawn the same way that blocks normally do when they fall off your vehicle, so you can use them to make persistent objects in the world like cones or traffic lights.

How do I put this… The world in Trailmakers is very orange. We’d love to add more maps in the game with different biomes. One of the biomes that we alluded to at the end of the Expedition is an alpine tundra. It would add some much needed diversity to the environments in the game of course, but it’s also a fun way to challenge the game design. This would also be a great opportunity to introduce skis and tank treads. 

As we get closer to the release of each of these updates, I’ll post a more in-depth description. Not mentioned above are all of requested features by the community. I will post about that next week, so stay tuned!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/QxBYFLL.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Trailmakers 0.5 - The Quality Update is live!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/5Q32kDm.png[/img]

When you update Trailmakers today, you will be able to play a brand new Trailmakers update. We call it the Quality Update because we have gone to great lengths to improve the performance of the game across the board. Input latency, stutters, long frames, RAM usage, and network have all seen great improvements.

If a huge update full of performance improvements does not sound like music to your ears (it should), we have also added a lot of cool features to the game including a race event where you can win a 3D print of your vehicle. Read more below, and have fun in Trailmakers!

[b]General[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Performance improvements![/b]
[list]
[*]Reduced input latency.
[*]Removed many frequent stutters.
[*]Removed the long frame when loading your vehicle. 
[*]Reduced RAM usage over longer play sessions.
[*]Rewrote a chunk of the network framework - should give fewer connection issues.[/list]
[/list]
[b]Race Island[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Race Event: Compete to win a 3D print of your vehicle. [/b]The first Trailmakers Race Event will run from April 12-19. The fastest time on the new Speed Circuit in the Formula Class will win a 3D print of their winning vehicle.
[*][b]New Race Track: [/b]We have heard you loud and clear! The Speed Circuit - a new tarmac-only race track has been added to Race Island.
[*][b]Racing Leagues: [/b]Every race now has 7 different leagues. They are Power Core limitations, and each have their own leaderboard. Compete in:
[list]
[*]Bionic League (0 Power Cores)
[*]Go-kart League (1 Power Core)
[*]Muscle League (2-5 Power Cores)
[*]Formula League (6-10 Power Cores)
[*]Jet League (11-15 Power Cores)
[*]Super Sonic League (16-30 Power Cores)
[*]Space League (Unlimited Power Cores)[/list]
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/2D9sJCp.jpg[/img]
[b]King’s Island[/b]
[list]
[*]When creating a Sandbox server, King’s Island can once again be selected as the map![/list]
[b]Sandbox Island[/b]
[list]
[*]The half pipes structures have had a slight redesign.[/list]
[b]Blocks[/b]
[list]
[*][b]NEW: Flat Connectors 1x2 - The flat connectors are lightweight blocks that can connect two surfaces with only minor visual protrusion[/b]
[*][b]NEW: Flat Connectors 1x3[/b]
[*][b]NEW: Flat Connectors 1x4[/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ncTW9iy.jpg[/img]
[*]CHANGED: Wheel - The standard wheel has a new look!
[*]CHANGED: Bulldawg Engine - The little engine that could now takes on your primary colour for a more distinct look.
[*]Destroyed blocks now keep their colour when turning to scrap. Pretty!
[*]All blocks in the propulsion category now have a Power Core cost.[/list]
[b]Builder[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Controller Support [/b]for the builder is now live. We are about 75% done with controller support, so don’t expect it to be completely bug free.
[*]Nudge Move - You can now nudge move a block by selecting it and pressing the arrow keys.
[*][b]Fixed input mapping[/b] - Your keybindings will no longer reset if you remove the seat from a vehicle, if you remove the part with binding from the vehicle, or if you repair the vehicle.
[*]Parts that are not connected to your vehicle now have a blinking exclamation mark to indicate they are unattached.[/list]
[b]UI[/b]
[list]
[*]The builder has new UI for vehicle info and hotkeys.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/OOOUKPc.png[/img]
[*]Error messages are now more descriptive.
[*]Implemented TextMesh Pro for improved text at various resolutions.
[*]The vehicle blueprints have a new stylish look!
[*]Added a shortcut to hide the UI - Ctrl and U![/list]
[b]Performance[/b]
[list]
[*]Made numerous improvements to garbage collection which will cause much fewer noticeable spikes.
[*]LODs tweaked throughout the game.
[*]Calculation optimisations when repairing.
[*]A bunch of optimisations when using the builder! Spawning in larger Blueprints and leaving/entering the builder should be much snappier!
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Monster Truck Wheels have brakes again!
[*]Fixed tear down flow issues.
[*]Fixed not being able to copy the VIP Seat referral link.
[*]Fixed the infinite scroll in the Steam Workshop UI.
[*]Fixed the issue with not being able to enter text in text fields.
[*]Fixed some render textures leaking upon switching islands.
[*]Fixed the close button not appearing when browsing the Steam Workshop in game.
[*]Fixed an issue with pressing Escape whilst the Quit Game pop up was displayed.
[*]Fixed block transitions in builder taking too long.
[*]Fixed an issue with RAM not being released correctly over extended play sessions.
[*]Fixed an issue when switching character whilst in game.
[*]Fixed an issue with the Escape menu being a little unresponsive.
[*]Fixed an issue with the FPS counter sometimes getting stuck when alt-tabbing.
[*]Fixed an issue with alt-tabbing affecting performance.
[*]Fixed an issue with the game failing to connect on the first attempt in a play session.
[*]Fixed an issue with the Transform menu if you deleted a Blueprint which was assigned to a Transform slot.
[*]Fixed the spooky ghost Blocks appearing.
[*]Fixed inconsistent lift from Helicoptor Servos.
[*]Fixed structures which have multiple seats placed after keybindings are set not functioning correctly.

[/list]

notes.title: Steam Workshop Beta is now on Upcoming and Update News!
notes.content:
[b]Hey Trailmakers![/b]

If you’ve been playing the game you’ve probably been eagerly watching the next update timer countdown for your next installment of Trailmakers content. Here at Flashbulb we’ve made the really tough decision to push the release of this update back and rather than give you two smaller updates in a month, we’ll roll it in to one larger update which will contain a mix of both new content, highly requested features and, most importantly - a whole host of bug fixes and performance improvements.

[b]But why? 😢[/b]

This is not a decision we take lightly, but we simply want our players to have the best possible experience when playing Trailmakers. Whether that be in single player Expedition, or having a four player drag race with friends. This delay will allow us to deliver a much more optimal experience both for existing players and also new players joining the world of Trailmakers.

For the curious amongst you, here are some of the features from our next update!

[list]
[*][b]We’ve heard your complaints in regards to performance and we've gone to great lengths with the coming update to provide players with a much better experience.[/b]
[*][b]Made several improvements to multiplayer performance. [/b]
[*][b]Made more optimisations in regards to input lag.[/b]
[*][b]A whole host of quality of life changes to the builder - including being able to nudge a block by one space.[/b]
[*][b]Made our error messages much more informative and useful.[/b]
[*][b]Steam Workshop support for Blueprints![/b]
[*][b]We’ve added controller support for build mode and generally improved the game experience when using a controller.[/b]
[*][b]Completely reworked keybinding set up.[/b]
[*][b]A new asphalt only Race Track on Race Island.[/b]
[*][b]We now have multiple leaderboards for each Race depending on the amount of Power Cores used.[/b]
[*][b]Improved the way Blueprints are displayed.[/b]
[*][b]More bug fixes than you can shake a rusty wrench at![/b][/list]

Once we get closer to releasing this update we’ll provide a full list of patch notes so you can see everything that’s changed. We really can’t wait to give you all this update as it will provide players with a greatly improved experience whilst also giving us a great foundation to work from and add the exciting stuff we have planned for the future!

[b]But what if I can’t wait?[/b]

For those of you who want to be at the forefront of Trailmakers, we’re putting a new build on our Upcoming Branch [b]which only includes the Steam Workshop part of the update![/b] Please keep in mind this is very much an in development version and you will almost certainly have weird things happen. But we’d love for you to create some awesome vehicles and share them with everyone and let us know on our [url=discord.gg/trailmakers]Discord[/url] when things go wrong!

notes.title: Introducing the Trailmakers Gallery...and some kind of workshop?!
notes.content:
[h1][b][u]Introducing the Trailmakers Gallery[/u][/b][/h1]

When we started developing Trailmakers the social aspect was always a core feature for us - not just being able to play with others, but also the ability to build something you were proud of and then share that easily with the world.

[url=https://gallery.playtrailmakers.com/]Trailmakers Gallery[/url] is our central hub for people to share their creations with the world and find a vehicle for every occasion. Once you’re signed in with your Steam account you can upvote creations, easily share them with others and of course upload your own!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28341931/7de453af018af5eb53d448f45b45785405afcd58.png[/img]

[h1][b][u]Why the gallery?[/u][/b][/h1]

We’re also bringing Trailmakers to Game Preview on Xbox One later this year and our goal is to allow people, regardless of the platform they’re playing on, to take a cool looking creation and bring it into their game. The Trailmakers Gallery allows us to do just that!

Whilst sharing blueprints on social media works it can also be quite easy for them to be lost or drowned out by newer content, but on the gallery they can be easily found again and with the included gif of the vehicle in action, you get a good idea of what the vehicle is like before you import it into your game!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/D7xkZmd.gif[/img]

[h1][b][u]So how does it work?[/u][/b][/h1]

Have a vehicle you want to upload to the gallery? Awesome! There’s a couple of things you need to do! First you need to save that vehicle, if you haven’t already! Next you need to capture a spritesheet of it in action. Got a cool off road buggy? Go zooming over some hills and then press F7 to save the previous six seconds of action! Now you have both things you need the next step is to head to the gallery, sign in with your Steam Account and press the Upload button!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28341931/8c1512993df08e858061aeb7fa6a1f9e2861e91a.png[/img]

You’ll see the above window. You need to give your creation a name, upload the two files you created earlier, include any specific instructions such as keybindings for special functions and then press Upload!

Now your creation is on the gallery for all to see! If you want to share it further you can easily do so by clicking the Share Icon and picking how you want to share it!

[h1][b][u]But what if I don’t want to use the gallery?![/u][/b][/h1]

That’s cool, we respect that. You’re of course welcome to share your creations however you want, and there’s a bunch of ways to do this!
[list]
[*]Posting them on our [url=discord.gg/trailmakers]Discord[/url]. Our Discord community is very active and you can find a wide variety of blueprints there and people love giving feedback and in some cases, people even refine what others have created. We’ve even seen members working collaboratively on more complex creations!
[*]Sharing them on Social Media. Since your vehicle is saved as a .PNG sharing your creations on Twitter, Facebook, Reddit. Imgur etc is quick and easy.
[*]On the Steam Community Hub.[/list]

Hmm, kinda feels like there’s an obvious method of sharing through Steam missing here, right? Then read on!

[h1][b][u]But what about Steam Workshop?[/u][/b][/h1]

We understand that not everybody is going to want to use the gallery, they just want easy, quick, in game access to cool stuff people have made. Steam Workshop support has been heavily requested by our community, and [b]I’m happy to announce today that Steam Workshop support for sharing blueprints is coming [i]very soon[/i].[/b]

In the meantime, if you have a cool creation, why not upload it to the [url=https://gallery.playtrailmakers.com/]Trailmakers Gallery[/url]? :)

notes.title: Race Island Update is Live!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/sOWuz0w.png[/img]

When you update Trailmakers today, you will be able to play on our brand new Race Island map. Build a record-breaking drag racer, smash the leaderboard in a jet plane time trial, or race your friends with go-karts. There's tons to do in the new Race Island update for Trailmakers! 

To make a better racing experience we have made a race challenge system, added a handful of new blocks, and improved the steering. Read more below, and thanks for having patience with us :)

[h1]Race Island[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]A brand new map is available in Single and Multiplayer - Race Island![/b]
[*]There are 7 different race courses available on Race Island in this update. They will require vehicles that can travel by land, air, or sea.
[*]Each race course has a race zone and a start zone. 
[list]
[*]The race zone is indicated by a semi-opaque blue wall. 
[*]The start zone is a yellow square grid. When all players who are in the course’s race zone are ALSO in the start zone, a countdown begins.[/list]
[*]Each race course has a leaderboard where you can see your fastest time, the current world record, your Steam Friends times, and the race times of people close (in time) to you. The # number indicates their world ranking.
[*]Pressing [BACKSPACE] will quit the race and teleport you to the start of the track. 
[R] will let you repair/respawn at the last checkpoint and continue the race.[/list]

[h1]General[/h1]
[list]
[*]Racing Camera - This camera will follow closely behind your vehicle for a great racing feel.
[*]Orbit Camera - This camera allows you to orbit freely around your vehicle without holding down the right mouse button.
[*]Added Motion Blur when driving fast! This can be turned off in Preferences.
[*]Added a few more names to the pre-order monument in Expedition.
[*]Added proper names for areas in the Expedition.
[*]We’ve added the ability to teleport to previously visited Checkpoints from the Map Screen in Expedition mode![/list]

[h1]Blocks[/h1]
[list]
[*][b](CHANGED): Dragon Jet Engine - The Dragon Jet Engine has had its weight increased to 30kg. We have made this change so it is more in line with the weight of the RAW Jet Engine and Mini-Thruster. Some of your flying vehicles might be affected greatly by this change - time to rebuild![/b]
[*](CHANGED): Mini-Thruster - The Mini-Thruster has increased power. 
[*](CHANGED): Hover Block - You can now configure it to turn on and off with a button press.
[*](CHANGED): Steering Hinge - You can now configure the angle of rotation. The sensitivity of the hinges when tapping the button has also been improved so it’s easier to make small adjustments when steering, and driving fast.
[*](CHANGED): Large Hinge - You can now configure the angle of rotation.
[*](CHANGED): Rotating Servo - You can now configure the angle of rotation.
[*](CHANGED): Suspension Spring - You can now configure the stiffness and damping. 
[*](CHANGED): Wheel - This wheel now has increased traction.
[*](CHANGED): Racing Wheel - Higher top speed than the regular wheel but less traction. Better traction on asphalt than sand. 
[*](CHANGED): Monster Truck Wheel - These wheels now have a much higher top speed, but are also heavier, and have MUCH better traction on all surfaces.
[*](CHANGED): Helicopter Servo - This servo now has TWO connection nubs on each side to accommodate the new Helicopter Blade. It now uses Power Cores, and has been moved to the Propulsion category. We have turned down the speed of the servo, but increased the lift of the blade to counter the decreased speed. (CHANGED): Helicopter Blade - Now has two connection nubs for better symmetry. The functionality has not changed which means there is still upwards propulsion no matter which way it spins. 
[*](CHANGED): Long Hood - New graphics.
[*](NEW): Large Wedge - A new block in the aerodynamic category.
[*](NEW): Long Wedge - A new block in the aerodynamic category.
[*](NEW): Small Wedge - A new block in the aerodynamic category.
[*](NEW): Corner Block - A new block in the aerodynamic category.
[*](NEW): Go-kart Wheel - The smallest wheel in the game.[/list]

[h1]Builder[/h1]
[list]
[*]Rotation no longer lets the block “wander”.
[*]Copying+rotating multiple blocks should not make them overlap inside each other.
[*]Easier to see when a block is attached (bounding box will turn green)[/list]

[h1]UI[/h1]
[list]
[*]We have a new UI for selecting game modes. The change was made to equally highlight all available game modes from the main menu.
[*]Added support for Ultra Widescreen resolution.[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed the description of a few blocks.
[*]Chickens should no longer levitate… as much. They are birds though, so give them a break.[/list]

notes.title: Race Island delayed until next week
notes.content:
Hi Trailmakers,

We promised you the Race Island Update would be live today, March 1st. Unfortunately we have run into some last-minute serious bugs with the update so we will be postponing it [b]until next week[/b]. We’re really sorry about this, but we’d rather give you something that works!

If you are extremely eager to try out the Race Island Update, you can switch to the ‘upcoming’ Beta branch. In a few hours, that branch will have a buggy version of the Race Island Update. If you find it too unstable, you can always go back to the Rings of Fire Update by selecting the Beta branch "none".

[img]https://i.imgur.com/yjl2lfX.png[/img]

Changing to upcoming beta is done like this. 

1.Right click on Trailmakers in the steam library.
2. Select properties.
3. Select the beta tab.
4. Change the drop down to 'upcoming'.

notes.title: Announcing: The Racing Update
notes.content:
[i]Concentrate on the moment. Feel, don't think. Trust your instincts.[/i]

It’s time to rev up your engines, tighten your suspension and strap an extra rocket to your favorite off-roader. The next Trailmakers content update is all about racing! Here are a few of the features we have planned for this update going live on [b]Thursday March 1st[/b].

[img]https://i.imgur.com/y7OOoHM.gif[/img]

[h1]Racing Map[/h1]
The brand new racing map will have several breakneck courses for you and other Trailmakers to compete on. Race in a solo time trial or compete with other players in 4-player multiplayer. Each race will have a leaderboard where you can see your Steam friends’ fastest time on a given track.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/T4RKeGV.gif[/img]

[h1]Improved driving feel[/h1]
We are making adjustments to the traction of all wheels as well as giving more detailed options on the steering hinges and rotating servos to give an overall improved feel of driving at high speeds. We’re also adding a much-requested new wheel to the game, and making the suspension springs adjustable.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Hkmshhh.gif[/img]

[h1]Nerfing all your planes[/h1]
… or as we like to call it - switching up the flight-meta. There are some glaring inconsistencies and unintended block-usage going on in the game that we are trying to adjust. These adjustments might mean that your favorite plane, rocket or helicopter no longer works after the update. We hope you’ll manage to rebalance your creation so it works with the new and more accurate blocks. Most notably, we’ve significantly increased the weight of the Dragon Jet, and reduced the lift of tail fins. For more detailed descriptions of the changes, make sure you read the patch notes when the update is released.

notes.title: Rings of Fire Update!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28341931/132e9e3cf1cfa39b2c4dce4772ea115482208c7d.png[/img]

Hey Trailmakers! Welcome to the Rings of Fire update! We have some exciting new stuff in this update, such as the addition of a Sonic Boom effect when you travel faster than the speed of sound!

Combined with our performance enhancing update we released earlier this week, we hope you’re getting revved up for our first [b]large content update coming at the start of March!

The Rings of Fire update will take Trailmakers from version 0.4.0.11398 to 0.4.1.11562.[/b]

[h1][b]General[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]We have added rings of fire around Sandbox Island. Take to the skies and see if you can fly through them all.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/a7hUdkQ.gif[/img]

[*]Wild chickens have appeared on Sandbox Island. There’s a reward for anyone who gets rid of them all.
[*]You can now generate a Sonic Boom!
[*]The Monument of pre-order names has been updated!
[*]We’ve added support for many more resolutions![/list]

[h1][b]UI[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]The Main Menu now shows the latest release notes, a countdown for the next update, the Weekly Challenge, refer-a-friend, and social links.
[list]
[*]The Weekly Challenge is our way of putting your creative skills to the test. Every Friday, we will announce the Weekly Challenge on our Twitch & Mixer Stream as well as awarding the winner of the previous week.
[*][b]The Refer-A-Friend promotion is now live. If you refer a friend to Trailmakers, and they buy the game after your referral, you will both receive the VIP Seat.[/b]
[*]Added clickable icons which take you to our Twitch and Mixer pages!
[*][b]Added a clickable icon to join our Discord and become part of the growing Trailmakers community! Share vehicles, get build ideas and receive help if you need it![/b][/list]
[/list]

[h1][b]Blocks[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Three new Accessory blocks for completing certain tasks on Sandbox Island…[/b]
[*]New VIP seat for referring a friend![/list]

[h1][b]Performance[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Made some changes to the start up flow so the initial load into the game should be quicker.
[*]Added support for many more resolutions!
[*]Reverted back to the game not starting in Exclusive Fullscreen mode.[/list]

[h1][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue with aerodynamic blocks that allowed warp machines to be created.
[*]Localisation fixes.
[*]Changed some of the Chaser AI in Expedition mode.[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes (0.4.0.11398) - Performance and CPU Complexity Limit Improvements!
notes.content:
In preparation for a smaller content update later this week we’re releasing our performance boosting patch which features several improvements that should greatly improve the experience for players! [b]We’ve also increased the CPU Complexity Limit in both Sandbox and Expedition mode[/b], so players should now be able to build even larger things! Good timing for our first of many [url=https://twitter.com/PlayTrailmakers/status/961987113871953920]Weekly Challenges![/url]

Read the full patch notes below, and stay tuned for another update coming later this week!

This will update Trailmakers from [b]0.4.0.10949[/b] to [b]0.4.0.11398.[/b]

[h1][b]General[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Added a Fullscreen toggle in the Preferences when accessed via the Main Menu![/b][/list]
[list]
[*]We updated the placeholder zipline and plank models with finished ones!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/oBFG0XA.gif[/img]
[*]Added a work in progress water splash when wheels are in water.

notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/lLWXNP3.png[/img]
Hey guys! We’ve just released a small but sweet update to the game with some critical fixes! This update takes the game from [b]0.4.0.10890[/b] to [b]0.4.0.10949[/b]. 

We’ve got more fixes incoming and we really appreciate everyone who has taken the time to bring issues to our attention, we even have a special reward in the works for those of you who go above and beyond when helping us track down issues, so stay tuned for news on that!

[list]

[*]Fixed an issue with some blocks magically rotating by themselves.
[*]Fixed some issues with build zones in small spaces.[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - Early Access (0.4.0.10890)
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/lLWXNP3.png[/img]
Early Access launch is finally here! The game has been through a lot of changes since our closed Alpha demo release last year, and we’re just getting started! For all the new Trailmakers joining us, these Release Notes contain all the major changes and additions we’ve made to the game since that first demo!

[b]General[/b]
[list]
[*][b]We’ve made a unique Sandbox Island, complete with Ball Puzzles, Ramps, Pipes and Hidden Cosmetic Items! You can play here alone or with up to three friends![/b]
[*]We’ve added a Free Cam mode whilst driving. Just hold down the right mouse button to look around, zoom in and out with the scroll wheel!
[*]We’ve added multiple different camera positions, just press C to cycle through them!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/uEq2JQw.gif[/img]
[*]We have removed the mini map.
[*]Pressing [TAB] now opens a map. You need to explore to uncover it all!
[*][b]The map screen will also display your progress for the island you’re currently on! Check how many Blocks, Power Cores and Bolts you’ve collected![/b]
[*]The Monument V1.0 is placed in the world! If you pre-ordered and responded to our emails asking which name you want displayed, if you don’t see your name don’t worry - we’ll be updating The Monument with more names as we receive them!
[*][b]We’ve added French, Italian, German, Spanish, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Portuguese (Brazilian), Polish and Danish localisations to the game.[/b]
[*]Character Customization is now available. Choose name, gender and main/secondary colours! You can also change these at any time from the Customization menu in game.
[*]Physics have been tweaked. This includes aerodynamics and water physics.
[*]The player character is no longer strapped into their seat tightly. They’ll lean into turns, jolt forward when braking and even fly out of their seat on large impacts. Safety first, kids!
[*][b]Basic Xbox One Controller support added. Now you can press B to repair, X to enter Build Mode, Y to enter/exit vehicle and A to activate the jets. MORE SPEEEEEEEED! [/b](Build mode is still keyboard and mouse only, we have big plans to improve our controller support!)
[*]Added a Time of Day slider to preferences - usable in Sandbox Island.
[*]The game now pauses when you press Escape!
[*]We added hints to Loading Screens!
[*]We updated to Unity 2017.3.0f2. Exciting!
[*]We updated the look of the water!
[*]Improved grammar on block descriptions!
[*]New Power Core Tutorial screen for new players!
[*]New dynamic force distribution! Larger structures should now react better than before when crashing, breaking and exploding.
[*]Some new ambient sounds when on Sandbox Island.
[*]The Enter Seat key has changed to F!
[*][b]We removed the Build Bubble.[/b]
[*]New, super early Sandbox world! Entering Sandbox mode from the main menu will take you here. You can still play Sandbox mode in the Expedition world by loading that world, and selecting Game Mode from the Escape Menu when in game!
[*]New micro explosion added.
[*]New block welding system v. 0.1! (I don’t know either!)
[*][b]We’ve introduced a CPU Complexity Value per block. The current limit is set to 1000, we’d love to hear your feedback regarding this limit, it’s by no means final![/b]
[*]Tiling on rocks increased = prettier mountains
[*][b]We’ve added so many new sounds to the game, both to blocks and to the world we’ve created, we hope you’ll enjoy them![/b]
[*]Awesome new loading screen when starting Expedition.
[*]Lots of backend changes to network code.[/list]

[b]Multiplayer[/b]
We have added a separate Multiplayer game mode called Dethrone that is accessible from the Main Menu. The objective is to hold on to the Crown for the longest amount of time, whilst trying your best to fend off attackers. Up to 4 players can join the same game. We have a lot of plans regarding new multiplayer game modes.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/K8l5FZQ.gif[/img]

[list]
[*][b]You can now play Sandbox Island in Multiplayer! No objectives or goals, just you and some friends building stuff and hanging out![/b]
[*]Multiplayer has a bunch of new sounds related to events!
[*]Multiplayer now has more options when creating a server! Infinite Power Cores, No canons, you choose!
[*]Added new Dethrone Introduction screen.
[*][b]You can now steal the crown by colliding with someone. Tag, you’re it![/b]
[*]You can now text chat in Multiplayer! Just hit enter to type! Sorry for the definitely placeholder Comic Sans!
[*]Removed player spawn positions from center island in King of the Hill
[*]Updated the bridges.
[*]More spawn points.
[*]Implemented hooks and data flow to detect one player damaging or killing other player (work in progress) + added full wheel trigger to wheels to allow bullets to hit and puncture wheels
[*]You can now earn XP whilst playing multiplayer, this is just the start, we’re planning on expanding what you can do with this!
[/list]

[b]Expedition[/b]
[list]
[*]We have completely rebuilt the Expedition world compared to the first Alpha Demo. It is a lot larger, more detailed, and has a lot more areas to explore and secrets to find!
[*][b]Animals [/b]- Be careful around the new wildlife in Trailmakers.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/kwo9hTK.gif[/img]
[*]We have removed the feature where you had to drag a block into a green beam to unlock a teleport station. 
[*]There are now two kinds of checkpoints - ones that just save your progress, and ones that save your progress and acts as fast travel points. You activate them by driving into them. 
[*]You can teleport to fast travel points by opening the map (TAB) and clicking on the point.
[*]Added a lot of pretty billboards at the start point.
[*][b]Added some billboards to the current end of the Expedition which tease upcoming content![/b]
[*]New ramp added allowing you to travel back to Jump Island from Wind Island.
[*]Climb Island has been slightly redesigned to improve the new player experience.
[*][b]Added crates around the islands...maybe there’s stuff hidden inside some of them...[/b]
[*]Improved lava look!
[*]The map has various landmark icons added to it to make navigation easier.
[*]Travelling between islands will display a drop down box showing your current collectible status and the name of the current island.
[*][b]The Jetpack is now disabled in Expedition mode.[/b][/list]


[b]Substance[/b]
We have removed the concept of ‘Substance’ from the game as we felt that it did not add to the overall enjoyment of the Expedition. Having to “farm” Substance quickly turned into a punishing grind if you were stuck on a certain hurdle. To limit the vehicle power level in Expedition we have introduced ‘Power Cores’. See “Builder Features” below for more info.

[b]Blocks[/b]
[list]
[*][b](NEW) Cosmetic Blocks - We’ve added many new Cosmetic Blocks which are unlocked in a variety of ways! You can find them hidden in both Expedition and Sandbox Island, you’ll get them as rewards from the Ball Puzzles on Sandbox Island and you’ll also receive them for collecting Bolts in Expedition mode! Happy hunting![/b]
[*][b](Changed)[/b] [b]Seat [/b]and engines are now explosive. If they suffer an impact, they will explode and the explosions can trigger other engines/seats.
[*][b](NEW) Block 1x4 [/b]- A larger variant of the 1x2 to allow you to build larger structures whilst also keeping the CPU Complexity cost down.
[*][b](NEW) Block 4x8 [/b]- A larger variant of the 2x4 to allow you to build larger structures whilst also keeping the CPU Complexity cost down.
[*][b](NEW) Small Modular Wing[/b] - A smaller version of the regular Modular Wing.
[*][b](NEW) Bulldawg Engine[/b] - Replaces the basic engine, and is now 2x2x1 instead of 2x2x2.
[*][b](NEW) Raw Engine[/b] - A more powerful engine than the Bulldawg Engine, but it weighs a lot.
[*][b](NEW) Dragon Engine[/b] - A very fast, but fragile engine.
[*][b](NEW) Hover Bloc[/b]k - A lift engine that generates an air cushion under your vehicle.
[*][b](NEW) Raw Jet Engine[/b] - A new jet engine that is bulky, powerful and overheats. Good for rocket-boosted cars.
[*][b](NEW) Dragon Jet Engine[/b] - Replaces the old jet engine. This jet does not overheat and is a good choice for flight.
[*][b](NEW) Mini-Thruster[/b] - Provides a small amount of thrust.
[*][b](NEW) Gimbal Jet[/b] - A jet that fires downwards.
[*][b](NEW) Propeller[/b] - Provides propulsive power.
[*][b](NEW) Tailfin[/b] - Provides drag and direction stability.
[*][b](NEW) Simple Tailfin [/b] - Provides drag and direction stability.
[*][b](NEW) Cannon[/b] - The first weapon to be added to the game. It fires ballistic projectiles that explode on impact.
[*][b](NEW) Small Cannon[/b] - A version of the Cannon that shoots faster with smaller projectiles.
[*][b](NEW) Trailer Hinge[/b] - A ball hinge with two attachment points.
[*][b](NEW) Helicopter Servo[/b] - This block is easier to use than the old spinning block when building a helicopter. 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/K0VIfr4.jpg[/img]
[*][b](NEW) Large Hinge[/b] - A hinge that is two blocks wide.
[*][b](NEW) Racing Wheel[/b] - These wheels are slick and good for drifting.
[*][b](NEW) Monster Truck Wheel[/b] - A much bigger wheel with good traction.
[*]We made some changes (not a nerf!) to wings, propellers and general lift physics. In short, you’ll need more speed to get airborne. Let us know what you think!
[*][b](Changed) Propeller [/b]- It spins properly!
[*][b](Changed) Wheels - [/b]New wheel damping logic.
[*][b](Changed) Aerodynamic Block [/b]- New look!
[*][b](Changed) Streamline 4x2 Block [/b] - New look!
[*][b](Changed) Cannon[/b] - New look!
[*][b](Changed) Cannons[/b] - Increased size of cannon bullets from 0 to 0.25 meters.
[*][b](Changed) Cannons[/b] - Added projectile hit effects to cannon.
[*][b](Changed) Cannons [/b]- Improved sound!
[*][b](Changed) Cannons[/b] - Added physical properties particle effect to bullet impacts.
[*][b](Changed) Wheels [/b]- Added puncture logic to wheels.
[b](Changed) Wheels [/b]- Added wheel brake sounds.
[*][b](Changed) Jets [/b]- Jet fire is now prettier.
[*][b](Changed) Large Hinge[/b] - Add sound effect.
[*][b](Changed) Hover Block[/b] - Added more connection points.
[*][b](Changed) Steering Hinge [/b]- You can now increase/decrease the speed which the hinges turn.
[*][b](Changed) Streamlined Block 1x2 - We found an issue with this block which we’ve fixed. This does mean however that any saved structures using this block, may have issues when trying to be spawned into the world. Sorry![/b]
[*]Aerodynamics function whilst transforming.
[*]Blocks now have LOD! Exciting!
[*]Various blocks have had their weight values tweaked. Let us know if you feel any of these changes are negative![/list]


[b]Builder[/b]
[list][*][b]Power Cores[/b] - Having a limit on how big you can build in the Expedition is crucial to making the environment challenging. Power Cores act as the way to limit the power of your vehicles. The Power Cores you collect stay with you the entire Expedition, but every engine you put on your vehicle reserves some of the Power Cores. If you remove the engine, the Power Core is freed up again. Check the Power Core cost of the engines in the builder menu.
[*][b]Block Count[/b] - You can now view the total block count of your vehicle in the top left corner
[*][b]Total Weight[/b] - You can now view the total weight of your vehicle in the top left corner
[*][b]Tinting [/b]- You now have the option to color some blocks. Click them and click the paint bucket tool to change the color. You can select multiple blocks and color them together.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/X9hIXJD.gif[/img]
[*][b]Rotation [/b]- You can now rotate a block by holding down [ALT] and clicking the rotation bar.
[*][b]Configurations [/b]- We have added a few new configurations to mechanical blocks.
[list]
[*][b]Toggle [/b]- In the keybindings menu, you can now put a checkmark under the keybinding if you want the key to toggle the mechanical block on/off instead of holding it down. 
[*][b]Delay [/b]- You can input a number of seconds delay before the mechanical block activates.
[*][b]Repeat [/b]- You can input a number of seconds after which the activation repeats.
[*][b]Speed [/b]- The speed at which the mechanical block activates can be adjusted on some blocks.[/list]

[*][b]Multi-select [/b]- You can select more than one block by clicking and dragging with the mouse or by holding down [CTRL] and clicking multiple blocks. 
[*][b]Multi-select configurations[/b] - When you have more than one block selected, if they are configurable you can “bulk configure” them. For example: You can select 4 hinges and change the key binding on all 4 at the same time.
[*][b]Transformation [/b]- Experimental feature that allows you to transform your vehicle into another vehicle when you are airborne. Check out the Transformation menu for more details.
[*][b]Blueprint History [/b]- If you forgot to save your vehicle, you can find the last versions you exited the builder with in the “History” tab.
[*][b]Import Blueprint [/b]- You can share your vehicles with other players by sending them the blueprint. The blueprint is saved as a .png picture with the save data stored in the picture! The “Import” button lets you browse your computer for blueprints and import them into your game. By default, your blueprints are saved in your “Documents”.
[*]Vehicles will no longer break on impact with the ground when you exit the builder.
[*]We removed the collider which prevented you from moving the camera underneath your vehicles when building! 
[*]Builder UI has some new, improved icons!
[*]You can now directly input a speed number rather than use the slider!
[*][b]Refactored Builder -[/b] We did an overhaul of the builder so things like snapping, group snapping and performance in builder should be much better!
[*]We changed the highlight of where a block will snap to to make it clearer.
[*][b]Copying Blocks [/b]- Copying a block with custom keybinds should now correctly copy the bindings.
[*][b]Custom Keybindings[/b] - Custom keybinds should now save correctly. [b](There is a known issue with keybindings resetting if you move a Block away from the structure, a fix for this should be in the very first update shortly after Early Access launch![/b]
[*]Implemented Power Core feedback when using blocks powered by them
[*]New category icons in builder UI![/list]


[b]Collectibles[/b]
We have added two collectibles to the Expedition - [b]Bolts [/b]and [b]Cosmetic Items[/b]. They are optional collectibles meant to give you a reason to explore the world. Some of them are found in plain sight while others are very tricky to collect, and will require weird vehicles or insane stunts. Who knows what you’ll get for collecting different amounts of Bolts...
[list]
[*]Players will now receive a message when trying to pick up Bolts on foot.[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Z4llbYm.gif[/img]

[b]Performance[/b]
[*]New quality settings for Fast and ugly: Maximum LOD level is now 1 but hard shadows are enabled.
[*]Added GPU instancing support to some materials.
[*]Forcing AnistropicTextures in the quality settings for Slow and Pretty + Medium settings.
[*]LED arrows no longer cast shadows.
[*]Cannon muzzle fire optimized.
[*]Big change in how blocks are now controlled graphics wise!
[*]All blocks now should be batching materials properly depending on whether they are in the world, inventory, builder or have become garbage.
[*]We’ve added and tweaked our LOD set in numerous places to help performance.
[*]Flags now have a stiff material for lower quality settings.
[*]Enabling GPU Instancing on some more materials[/list]


[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]We fixed the particles from the Triple Exhaust!
[*]Fixed Knob pairs not being properly removed on some despawning. This caused edges to not be removed correctly.
[*]Fixed scaling on Stackable Message when description text was very long.
[*]Fixed TutorialHint MessageBox to handle mulitline text + small animation change
[*]Fixed Transformation killing you.
[*]Made a boolean for InputSeat, so it knows if it knows it's last velocity.
[*]Fixed issue where sockets would be left open and you could not reconnect to a game if you select manual client port
[*]Added "LetsThroughAirFlow" bool to metadata and implemented check in aerodynamic blocking logic (AKA made helicopters work again)
[*]Fixed the Spike Rims.
[*]Fixed decals on some exhaust and intake Cosmetic Items.
[*]Fixed Color mismatch in inventory background ( Changed background to use Color instead of Material )
[*]Fixed position-offset in inventory background pattern
[*]Fixed toggle-highlighting in inventory main-tab-toggles
[*]Made jet not spout particles in builder.
[*]Fixed those pesky scrollbars not showing in inventory
[*]Fixed searching for non password protected servers
[*]Null guard in RemoveStructure, so it doesn't try to remove weldgroups from structures in buildmode.
[*]Fix for DoSpawn being called on an object that was already despawned.
[*]Guard for pulling in a structure with no unlocked blocks clientside.
[*]Guard for respawning flow calling a repfunc after being destroyed by teardown.
[*]Fixed the Cosmetics catergories.
[*]Fixed issue where client could get stuck when not being able to reach backend
[*]Fixed blocks references in buildsystem - And despawning of blocks in build, if the player disconnects.
[*]Fixed servers dropping off the list while active
[*]Fix for spawn parenting
[*]Fixed offset for rootnode to rest of structure, so Transformation uses correct boundscheck
[*]Fixing issue where server names with special characters ended up with ? in them
[*]Fix for despawn on teardown not being called
[*]Fixed Propeller not turning into garbage
[*]Fixed keybindings being forgotten, again!
[*]Fixed the tutorial getting stuck during the Steering Hinge and Wheel phase.
[*]Fixed the Cosmetic Block reward pop up displaying multiple times for each player in the session in Sandbox Island.
[*]Fixing issue where the game would hang in connecting if trying to join an non existing server
[*]You will no longer need to repeat the tutorial when entering Sandbox mode.
[*]The checkpoints between islands now activate correctly.
[*]Fixed the issue with repairing blocks causing custom key bindings resetting.
[*]The Piston block now has functioning initial key binding.
[*]Fix for multiple crown pickups spawning in King of the Hill.
[*]Fixed missing countdown in King of the Hill game mode.
[*]Fixed the Trailmakers Logo remaining visible after the epic jump.
[*]Fix for rotation of hinges in builder.
[*]Numerous marquee tool and hover fixes in builder
[*]Engine glow fixed.
[*]Fixed some ramps not having colliders.
[*]Fixed structures not being removed when respawning players.
[*]Fixed Powercore stacking in HUD
[*]Fix for the weird particle system bug.
[*]Fixed build-sounds on various new blocks.
[*]Fix for clients crashing server when joining from an old session.
[*]Localization fixes.
[*]Fixed builder categories screwing up when switching categories rapidly.
[*]Rubber vs metal is now only smoke.
[*]Fixed single frame without jets.
[*]Fixing issue where seat could not be placed because of an issue with obfuscated compression hints.
[*]Fixed players respawning without their current structure when a round ends while they are in the builder, and have yet to exit the builder. This error also made them unable to reenter the builder upon leaving it.
[*]Changes to make sure players have a minimum number of Power Cores when they reach hover island.
[*]Fixed customaxes input being set when reseating a character in transformations.
[*]Fixed all multi-part blocks, if they end up in same weld group.
[*]Fixed Power Core cost of multi-part blocks.
[*]Fixed stupid issue in hingeblock logic + implemented TakeDamageResult in damage system.
[*]Added colliders to the triangular checkpoints.
[*]Standard impact is now a subtle smoke effect. Sand particles are for sand impacts only.
[*]Fixed being able to pick up the crown while repairing.[/list]

[b]Builder[/b]
[list][*][b]Power Cores[/b] - Having a limit on how big you can build in the Expedition is crucial to making the environment challenging. Power Cores act as the way to limit the power of your vehicles. The Power Cores you collect stay with you the entire Expedition, but every engine you put on your vehicle reserves some of the Power Cores. If you remove the engine, the Power Core is freed up again. Check the Power Core cost of the engines in the builder menu.
[*][b]Block Count[/b] - You can now view the total block count of your vehicle in the top left corner
[*][b]Total Weight[/b] - You can now view the total weight of your vehicle in the top left corner
[*][b]Tinting [/b]- You now have the option to color some blocks. Click them and click the paint bucket tool to change the color. You can select multiple blocks and color them together.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/X9hIXJD.gif[/img]
[*][b]Rotation [/b]- You can now rotate a block by holding down [ALT] and clicking the rotation bar.
[*][b]Configurations [/b]- We have added a few new configurations to mechanical blocks.
[list]
[*][b]Toggle [/b]- In the keybindings menu, you can now put a checkmark under the keybinding if you want the key to toggle the mechanical block on/off instead of holding it down. 
[*][b]Delay [/b]- You can input a number of seconds delay before the mechanical block activates.
[*][b]Repeat [/b]- You can input a number of seconds after which the activation repeats.
[*][b]Speed [/b]- The speed at which the mechanical block activates can be adjusted on some blocks.[/list]

[*][b]Multi-select [/b]- You can select more than one block by clicking and dragging with the mouse or by holding down [CTRL] and clicking multiple blocks. 
[*][b]Multi-select configurations[/b] - When you have more than one block selected, if they are configurable you can “bulk configure” them. For example: You can select 4 hinges and change the key binding on all 4 at the same time.
[*][b]Transformation [/b]- Experimental feature that allows you to transform your vehicle into another vehicle when you are airborne. Check out the Transformation menu for more details.
[*][b]Blueprint History [/b]- If you forgot to save your vehicle, you can find the last versions you exited the builder with in the “History” tab.
[*][b]Import Blueprint [/b]- You can share your vehicles with other players by sending them the blueprint. The blueprint is saved as a .png picture with the save data stored in the picture! The “Import” button lets you browse your computer for blueprints and import them into your game. By default, your blueprints are saved in your “Documents”.
[*]Vehicles will no longer break on impact with the ground when you exit the builder.
[*]We removed the collider which prevented you from moving the camera underneath your vehicles when building! 
[*]Builder UI has some new, improved icons!
[*]You can now directly input a speed number rather than use the slider!
[*][b]Refactored Builder -[/b] We did an overhaul of the builder so things like snapping, group snapping and performance in builder should be much better!
[*]We changed the highlight of where a block will snap to to make it clearer.
[*][b]Copying Blocks [/b]- Copying a block with custom keybinds should now correctly copy the bindings.
[*][b]Custom Keybindings[/b] - Custom keybinds should now save correctly. [b](There is a known issue with keybindings resetting if you move a Block away from the structure, a fix for this should be in the very first update shortly after Early Access launch![/b]
[*]Implemented Power Core feedback when using blocks powered by them
[*]New category icons in builder UI![/list]


[b]Collectibles[/b]
We have added two collectibles to the Expedition - [b]Bolts [/b]and [b]Cosmetic Items[/b]. They are optional collectibles meant to give you a reason to explore the world. Some of them are found in plain sight while others are very tricky to collect, and will require weird vehicles or insane stunts. Who knows what you’ll get for collecting different amounts of Bolts...
[list]
[*]Players will now receive a message when trying to pick up Bolts on foot.[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Z4llbYm.gif[/img]

[b]Performance[/b]
[*]New quality settings for Fast and ugly: Maximum LOD level is now 1 but hard shadows are enabled.
[*]Added GPU instancing support to some materials.
[*]Forcing AnistropicTextures in the quality settings for Slow and Pretty + Medium settings.
[*]LED arrows no longer cast shadows.
[*]Cannon muzzle fire optimized.
[*]Big change in how blocks are now controlled graphics wise!
[*]All blocks now should be batching materials properly depending on whether they are in the world, inventory, builder or have become garbage.
[*]We’ve added and tweaked our LOD set in numerous places to help performance.
[*]Flags now have a stiff material for lower quality settings.
[*]Enabling GPU Instancing on some more materials[/list]


[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]We fixed the particles from the Triple Exhaust!
[*]Fixed Knob pairs not being properly removed on some despawning. This caused edges to not be removed correctly.
[*]Fixed scaling on Stackable Message when description text was very long.
[*]Fixed TutorialHint MessageBox to handle mulitline text + small animation change
[*]Fixed Transformation killing you.
[*]Made a boolean for InputSeat, so it knows if it knows it's last velocity.
[*]Fixed issue where sockets would be left open and you could not reconnect to a game if you select manual client port
[*]Added "LetsThroughAirFlow" bool to metadata and implemented check in aerodynamic blocking logic (AKA made helicopters work again)
[*]Fixed the Spike Rims.
[*]Fixed decals on some exhaust and intake Cosmetic Items.
[*]Fixed Color mismatch in inventory background ( Changed background to use Color instead of Material )
[*]Fixed position-offset in inventory background pattern
[*]Fixed toggle-highlighting in inventory main-tab-toggles
[*]Made jet not spout particles in builder.
[*]Fixed those pesky scrollbars not showing in inventory
[*]Fixed searching for non password protected servers
[*]Null guard in RemoveStructure, so it doesn't try to remove weldgroups from structures in buildmode.
[*]Fix for DoSpawn being called on an object that was already despawned.
[*]Guard for pulling in a structure with no unlocked blocks clientside.
[*]Guard for respawning flow calling a repfunc after being destroyed by teardown.
[*]Fixed the Cosmetics catergories.
[*]Fixed issue where client could get stuck when not being able to reach backend
[*]Fixed blocks references in buildsystem - And despawning of blocks in build, if the player disconnects.
[*]Fixed servers dropping off the list while active
[*]Fix for spawn parenting
[*]Fixed offset for rootnode to rest of structure, so Transformation uses correct boundscheck
[*]Fixing issue where server names with special characters ended up with ? in them
[*]Fix for despawn on teardown not being called
[*]Fixed Propeller not turning into garbage
[*]Fixed keybindings being forgotten, again!
[*]Fixed the tutorial getting stuck during the Steering Hinge and Wheel phase.
[*]Fixed the Cosmetic Block reward pop up displaying multiple times for each player in the session in Sandbox Island.
[*]Fixing issue where the game would hang in connecting if trying to join an non existing server
[*]You will no longer need to repeat the tutorial when entering Sandbox mode.
[*]The checkpoints between islands now activate correctly.
[*]Fixed the issue with repairing blocks causing custom key bindings resetting.
[*]The Piston block now has functioning initial key binding.
[*]Fix for multiple crown pickups spawning in King of the Hill.
[*]Fixed missing countdown in King of the Hill game mode.
[*]Fixed the Trailmakers Logo remaining visible after the epic jump.
[*]Fix for rotation of hinges in builder.
[*]Numerous marquee tool and hover fixes in builder
[*]Engine glow fixed.
[*]Fixed some ramps not having colliders.
[*]Fixed structures not being removed when respawning players.
[*]Fixed Powercore stacking in HUD
[*]Fix for the weird particle system bug.
[*]Fixed build-sounds on various new blocks.
[*]Fix for clients crashing server when joining from an old session.
[*]Localization fixes.
[*]Fixed builder categories screwing up when switching categories rapidly.
[*]Rubber vs metal is now only smoke.
[*]Fixed single frame without jets.
[*]Fixing issue where seat could not be placed because of an issue with obfuscated compression hints.
[*]Fixed players respawning without their current structure when a round ends while they are in the builder, and have yet to exit the builder. This error also made them unable to reenter the builder upon leaving it.
[*]Changes to make sure players have a minimum number of Power Cores when they reach hover island.
[*]Fixed customaxes input being set when reseating a character in transformations.
[*]Fixed all multi-part blocks, if they end up in same weld group.
[*]Fixed Power Core cost of multi-part blocks.
[*]Fixed stupid issue in hingeblock logic + implemented TakeDamageResult in damage system.
[*]Added colliders to the triangular checkpoints.
[*]Standard impact is now a subtle smoke effect. Sand particles are for sand impacts only.
[*]Fixed being able to pick up the crown while repairing.[/list]

notes.title: Vehicular construct-o-sandbox Trailmakers enters early access next week
notes.content:
Developed by the team formerly known as Press Play (makers of the Max & The Magic Marker games and Kalimba), Trailmakers (itself formerly known as Pioneers) is yet another of those things. In fact, it’s two of them, blending the survival sandbox and physics tinker-toolset subgenres.

Flashbulb hope to offer a pleasing blend of open-world exploration and creative problem solving using whatever nuts, bolts and conveniently cuboid construction blocks you can gather, and the fruits of their labor will be available to play – albeit as a work-in-progress – this Wednesday, January 31st.

(more…)

notes.title: Getting ready for launch (aka "Oh no, my game is gone!")
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

I hope you enjoyed the Open Weekend of Trailmakers - we were overwhelmed by the amount of players, feedback and cool vehicles. A big thank you to everyone who tried it. We can't wait to see what you do with the game when we launch on Early Access on the 31st of January.

In preparation for the launch and our Steam review, we have revoked all Alpha Test keys. To everyone who pre-ordered the game, you will receive a NEW key for the final version on the 31st. We will soon be in contact with players who pre-ordered about getting their name engraved in a mountain in the game.

notes.title: Free Weekend!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/cdwx3Qn.png[/img]

Make sure you don't miss the Trailmakers Free Weekend later this month! EVERYONE is invited, as long as you sign up on [url=http://www.playtrailmakers.com/open-weekend]PlayTrailmakers.com[/url]. 

The Open Weekend will be a stress test of the multiplayer game modes in Trailmakers. Only sandbox and multiplayer will be availabe, so if you are excited to try the Expedition, you will have to wait until the full game release on January 31st. 

Remember to invite your friends to join us in the weekend - or find new friends to play with on our [url=http://discord.gg/Trailmakers]official Discord channel[/url].

notes.title: Patch Notes - Trailmakers Alpha2 (0.3.1.9428)
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/lLWXNP3.png[/img]

Happy holidays everyone! Here’s the patch notes for the latest update to Alpha2 (0.3.1.9428)!

[b]General[/b]
[list]
[*]The player character is no longer strapped into their seat tightly. They’ll lean into turns, jolt forward when braking and even fly out of their seat on large impacts. Safety first, kids!
[*]More basic Xbox One Controller support added. Now you can press B to repair, X to enter Build Mode, Y to enter/exit vehicle and A to activate the jets. MORE SPEEEEEEEED!
[*]The game now pauses when you press Escape!
[*]The fog on Sandbox Isle has cleared up!
[*]Some new hints!
[*]“A mess of updates” - From one of our designers, Asger.
[*]We updated to Unity 2017.3.0f2. Exciting!
[*]We updated the look of the water!
[*]Improved grammar on block descriptions!
[*]New Power Core Tutorial screen for new players!
[*]New dynamic force distribution! Larger structures should now react better than before when crashing, breaking and exploding.
[*]Some new ambient sounds when on Sandbox Island.
[*]The Bolt pickups are no longer called Stars in the UI. RIP Stars.[/list]

[b]Multiplayer[/b]
[list]
[*]You can now play Sandbox Island in Multiplayer! No objectives or goals, just you and some friends building stuff and hanging out!
[*]Multiplayer has a bunch of new sounds related to events!
[*]Added even more pretty UI elements.[/list]

[b]Expedition[/b]
[list]
[*]More ball puzzles!
[*]Ball Puzzle Goal has a new texture.
[*]Added a lot of pretty billboards at the start point.
[*]New ramp added allowing you to travel back to Jump Island from Wind Island.
[/list]

[b]Blocks[/b]
[list]
[*]We made some changes (not a nerf!) to wings, propellers and general lift physics. In short, you’ll need more speed to get airborne. Let us know what you think!
[*][b](Changed) Propeller [/b]- It spins properly!
[*]Blocks now have LOD! Exciting!
[*][b](Changed) Wheels - [/b]New wheel damping logic.[/list]

[b]Builder[/b]
[list]
[*]We removed the collider which prevented you from moving the camera underneath your vehicles when building! 
[*]Builder UI has some new, improved icons!
[*]You can now directly input a speed number rather than use the slider![/list]

[b]Performance[/b]
[list]
[*]We’ve added and tweaked our LOD set in numerous places to help performance.[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Applied colliders to rocks and other things around the world.
[*]Fixed the King not dropping his crown upon death.
[*]Fixed the planet on the loading screen.
[*]Fixes to some of the earlier Ball Puzzles.
[*]Suspension Block is now displayed correctly.
[*]Better seat distance detection when trying to enter a seat.
[*]Fixed hinges not removing their joints upon being scrapped.
[*]Fixed one of the jumps on Jump Island.
[*]Some of the Quit to Main Menu errors have been banished. Some escaped.
[*]The stat screen that appears between Islands doesn’t display anymore when in Sandbox Mode.
[*]Fixed an issue in which the game would hang when trying to connect to a server that no longer existed.
[*](Hopefully) fixed the crash which happened when Quitting the game.[/list]

notes.title: Vehicle sandbox Trailmakers will hit Early Access next month after a free weekend
notes.content:
We got our first look at Trailmakers, a sandbox construction game that looks like Besiege but with cars and planes, at PAX West earlier this year. Today, developer Flashbulb Games announced Trailmakers will hit Steam Early Access on January 31, 2018, with a free open beta weekend planned for January 11 - 14. It will cost $20 at launch, and its Steam page says the price "will be reviewed" when the Early Access period ends. 

Flashbulb says the Early Access build will feature three game modes. Creative mode is singleplayer and gives you infinite resources to build the car-plane-thing of your dreams. There are over 40 vehicles parts in total, including a "transformer part" that lets you switch forms mid-drive. Expedition mode is also singleplayer, but comes with a specific goal: reach the other end of an obstacle-laden island. So, you have to design a vehicle capable of scaling cliffs and clearing gaps, and then drive it yourself. 

The third mode is Dethroned, a multiplayer mode described as a "fusion of capture the flag and king of the hill." Up to four players can queue into a match to built battle vehicles and crash them into each other in the noble name of science. Flashbulb reckons their "physics-over-network" tech will keep matches "synchronized perfectly between players," which is a bold claim for an Early Access game. 

You can learn more about Trailmakers in our interview with creative director Mikkel Thorsted, and on its official site.

notes.title: Patch Notes - Changes from Alpha Demo to first Early Access Test
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/RkPO1im.png[/img]
We have begun testing the version of Trailmakers that will eventually become the Early Access game available for purchase on Steam. This is the first update we have sent out since the Alpha Demo from April, and A LOT of things have happened to the game. Check out some (most?) of the changes below.

If you want to help us test Trailmakers before it is released on Steam Early Access, head over to [url=http://www.playtrailmakers.com]PlayTrailmakers.com[/url] and sign up. Have patience with us. We send out invites every week, but still at a small scale until the game is more stable. If you want to chat with the developers or the testers, head over to our [url=http://discord.gg/trailmakers]Official Discord[/url].

[h1]General[/h1]
[list]
[*]You can now hold down right click to control the camera, and zoom in and out with the scroll wheel.
[*]Pressing [TAB] now opens a map. The fog of war conceals where you haven’t yet been. 
[*]We have removed the mini map.
[*]Character Customization is now available. Choose name, gender and main/off colors for your character.
[*]Physics have been tweaked. This includes aerodynamics and water physics.
[/list]
[h1]Multiplayer[/h1]
We have added a separate Multiplayer game mode that is accessible from the Main Menu. The objective is to hold on to the Crown for the longest amount of time, whilst trying your best to fend off attackers. Up to 4 players can join the same game. We have a lot of plans concerning new multiplayer game modes.

We also plan on making the Expedition/Sandbox world multiplayer ready at a later stage.

[h1]Expedition[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Environment[/b] - We have completely rebuilt the Expedition world compared to the Alpha Demo. It is a lot larger, more detailed, and has a lot more areas to explore.
[*][b]Animals[/b] - Be careful around the new wildlife in Trailmakers.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/kwo9hTK.gif[/img]
[*]We have removed the feature where you had to drag a block into a green beam to unlock a teleport station. 
[*]There are now two kinds of checkpoints - ones that just save your progress, and ones that save your progress and acts as fast travel points. You activate them by driving into them. 
[*]You can teleport to fast travel points by opening the map (TAB) and clicking on the point.
[/list]
[h1]Substance[/h1]
We have removed the concept of ‘Substance’ from the game as we felt that it did not add to the overall enjoyment of the Expedition. Having to “farm” Substance quickly turned into a punishing grind if you were stuck on a certain hurdle. To limit the vehicle power level in Expedition we have introduced ‘Power Cores’. See “Builder Features” below for more info.

[h1]Blocks[/h1]
[list]
[*][b](Changed) Seat and engines[/b] are now explosive. If they suffer an impact, they will explode and the explosions can trigger other engines/seats.
[*][b](NEW) Small Modular Wing[/b] - A smaller version of the regular Modular Wing.
[*][b](NEW) Bulldawg Engine[/b] - Replaces the basic engine, and is now 2x2x1 instead of 2x2x2.
[*][b](NEW) Raw Engine[/b] - A more powerful engine than the Bulldawg Engine, but it weighs a lot.
[*][b](NEW) Dragon Engine[/b] - A very fast, but fragile engine.
[*][b](NEW) Hover Block[/b] - A lift engine that generates an air cushion under your vehicle.
[*][b](NEW) Raw Jet Engine[/b] - A new jet engine that is bulky, powerful and overheats. Good for rocket-boosted cars.
[*][b](NEW) Dragon Jet Engine[/b] - Replaces the old jet engine. This jet does not overheat and is a good choice for flight.
[*][b](NEW) Mini-Thruster[/b] - Provides a small amount of thrust.
[*][b](NEW) Gimbal Jet[/b] - A jet that fires downwards.
[*][b](NEW) Propeller[/b] - Provides propulsive power.
[*][b](NEW) Tailfin[/b] - Provides drag and direction stability.
[*][b](NEW) Cannon[/b] - The first weapon to be added to the game. It fires ballistic projectiles that explode on impact.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/lQFnHvc.gif[/img]
[*][b](NEW) Small Cannon[/b] - A version of the Cannon that shoots faster with smaller projectiles.
[*][b](NEW) Trailer Hinge[/b] - A ball hinge with two attachment points.
[*][b](NEW) Helicopter Servo[/b] - This block is easier to use than the old spinning block when building a helicopter. 
[*][b](NEW) Large Hinge[/b] - A hinge that is two blocks wide.
[*][b](NEW) Racing Wheel[/b] - These wheels are slick and good for drifting.
[*][b](NEW) Monster Truck Wheel[/b] - A much bigger wheel with good traction.
[*][b](NEW) Vanity Blocks[/b] - A few new vanity blocks were added, and many more are to come.
[/list]
[h1]Builder features[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Power Cores[/b] - Having a limit on how big you can build in the Expedition is crucial to making the environment challenging. Power Cores act as the way to limit the power of your vehicles. The Power Cores you collect stay with you the entire Expedition, but every engine you put on your vehicle reserves some of the Power Cores. If you remove the engine, the Power Core is freed up again. Check the Power Core cost of the engines in the builder menu.
[*][b]Block Count[/b] - You can now view the total block count of your vehicle in the top left corner
[*][b]Total Weight[/b] - You can now view the total weight of your vehicle in the top left corner
[*][b]Tinting[/b] - You now have the option to color some blocks. Click them and click the paint bucket tool to change the color. You can select multiple blocks and color them together.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/X9hIXJD.gif[/img]
[*][b]Rotation[/b] - You can now rotate a block by holding down [ALT] and clicking the rotation bar.
[*][b]Configurations[/b] - We have added a few new configurations to mechanical blocks.
[*][b]Toggle[/b] - In the keybindings menu, you can now put a checkmark under the keybinding if you want the key to toggle the mechanical block on/off instead of holding it down. 
[*][b]Delay[/b] - You can input a number of seconds delay before the mechanical block activates.
[*][b]Repeat[/b] - You can input a number of seconds after which the activation repeats.
[*][b]Speed[/b] - The speed at which the mechanical block activates can be adjusted on some blocks.
[*][b]Multi-select[/b] - You can select more than one block by clicking and dragging with the mouse or by holding down [CTRL] and clicking multiple blocks. 
[*][b]Multi-select configurations[/b] - When you have more than one block selected, if they are configurable you can “bulk configure” them. For example: You can select 4 hinges and change the key binding on all 4 at the same time.
[*][b]Build bubble[/b] - We have added an invisible bubble that limits how far from your character you can build, and how big a vehicle you can build. This is mostly a measure to stop players from building into walls, scenery and other players. If you find the bubble to be too small, do let us know.
[*][b]Transformation[/b] - Experimental feature that allows you to transform your vehicle into another vehicle when you are airborne. Check out the Transformation menu for more details.
[*][b]Blueprint History[/b] - If you forgot to save your vehicle, you can find the last versions you exited the builder with in the “History” tab.
[*][b]Import Blueprint[/b] - You can share your vehicles with other players by sending them the blueprint. The blueprint is saved as a .png picture with the save data stored in the picture! The “Import” button lets you browse your computer for blueprints and import them into your game. By default, your blueprints are saved in your “Documents”.
[*]Vehicles will no longer break on impact with the ground when you exit the builder.
[/list]
[h1]Collectibles[/h1]
We have added two collectibles to the Expedition - Bolts and Secrets. They are optional collectibles meant to give you a reason to explore the world. Some of them are very tricky to collect, and will require weird vehicles or insane stunts. We are still working on a reward for players who catch... them all.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Z4llbYm.gif[/img]

notes.title: Development Update #8 - Multiplayer
notes.content:
Hi everyone! We’re back with another development update, and it’s one we’ve been looking forward to. It’s about multiplayer in Trailmakers.

When we set out to make Trailmakers, a game where you build your own vehicle in a big world with multiplayer, we stumbled on a big technical challenge. Every time a dune buggy crashes into a drag racer at high speed, hundreds of vehicle parts go flying in every direction. Each of these parts have a trajectory that needs to be calculated and shared between players which leads to enormous amounts of calculations to simulate real physics.  This takes a real toll on computers. Our programmers have spent many months making this work smoothly, and we are getting there. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/hc2Trlq.gif[/img]
[i]This is what a multiplayer collision looks like from both sides[/i]

So what will Multiplayer be like when Early Access launches?

When we launch Trailmakers on the Steam Early Access program, the most groundbreaking multiplayer feature will be the real-time physics over network - a feature that lets you and your friends experience some very cool vehicle destruction. To set the scene for crashes, we have created a multiplayer mini game - the first of many to come. The game mode will support up to 4 players and is a ton of fun! What kind of mini game mode is it? More on that when we get closer to launch 😉 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/PSuoSbA.gif[/img]
[i]Now with dust trails[/i]

Anyone can host a multiplayer game and play with their friends, but we do recommend that the person with the fastest computer and internet connection is the host. The game’s physics calculations are done by the host’s PC, and then sent to the other players so everything is completely in sync. The more blocks are in the game, the more physics calculations are needed, and the slower the game will run. If every player decides to build something extremely elaborate, you might experience some performance issues.

During Early Access, we will optimize the open-world Sandbox and Expedition modes to be multiplayer compatible. We also plan on taking full advantage of your feedback during Early Access, so a lot of future multiplayer competitions will depend on your suggestions. 
[b]If you have a great idea for a multiplayer game mode, let us know in the comments! [/b]

PS. If you want to see the current state of the game or have a burning question you want answered, tune in to our first Dev Stream this Friday (September 29th) at 2PM UTC+1 on www.twitch.tv/PlayTrailmakers - Follow the channel if you want a notification when we go live.
